reason: Recovered-branch ARCHIVE, not live code: 18 snapshots of test files from abandoned branches, several of them older copies of files that still exist elsewhere in the tree. Running them would assert against code that was deliberately not merged. Excluded at the bunfig.toml pathIgnorePatterns layer, so bun cannot discover them from any invocation; this entry is the written half of that exclusion.

MEASURED 2026-08-13: creates a real kind cluster named zeta-ci and installs ArgoCD plus the Gateway API CRDs, with no CI guard. That is minutes of runner time, a docker-in-runner dependency, and shared mutable state on any machine that runs it, a developer laptop included. The k8s surface has its own lane in k8s-argocd-health-test.yml. Un-ignoring this needs an env-gated skip inside the test, which belongs to whoever owns the cluster harness.

MEASURED 2026-08-13, reproduced twice: runHealthCheck probes the live repository over the network, and its single test times out after 60s, carrying the file to 93s wall-clock and failing. The other 50 tests in the file pass in under a second. It is a live-environment probe wearing a unit-test name, so it cannot join the PR lane until that one test is separated or gated. Losing 50 real assertions to keep it out is a genuine cost, recorded here rather than hidden.
